name: TrackingNet
description: A large-scale object-tracking dataset and benchmark with more than 30,000 videos and over 14 million dense bounding-box annotations.
citation: Müller, M., Bibi, A., Giancola, S., Al-Subaihi, S., & Ghanem, B. (2018). TrackingNet: A Large-Scale Dataset and Benchmark for Object Tracking in the Wild. arXiv:1803.10794. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.1803.10794
